_about: Altered Beast, the alternate equipment set from cousinoer5's Altered Insanity, as a DT3+ mod. It replaces some of the game's scripts and object events with DT3+'s versions that have Altered Insanity's changes in them: merged by tools/modkit/mergemod.py (python mergemod.py init|update|check altered_beast/config.json) and finished by hand in merged/, then built with python tools/modkit/convert.py altered_beast/config.json. Its new objects (special attacks, the altered enemies its room shows) are ported to DT3+'s 60fps code by hand in ported/ (new_objects_legacy: any that aren't run as 30fps code). 'vanilla' is the original game split with gmksplit: the DT3_v1_5_2_4_v120_gmksplit folder of this repository's commit fe70bd6d, unzipped into tools/modkit/_vanilla (git archive --format=zip -o vanilla.zip fe70bd6d DT3_v1_5_2_4_v120_gmksplit). Paths are this computer's.

rBT_HUB.why: the Altered Beast's: the ledge at the top right (with its solid), its two signs and the door to the Altered Beast's room (the rest is Virtual Insanity's)
rBT_HUB.why_room_code: the added room code is Virtual Insanity's (its boss challenges)

mod.name: Altered Beast
mod.author: cousinoer5 (merged with DT3+)
mod.description: Altered Insanity's alternate equipment set: every piece of equipment altered, special attacks paid for in green health, curses and challenge options. Type alterme on the title screen before a new game, or find the Altered Beast once the game is beaten. It replaces some of the game's own scripts and object events with versions made from DT3+'s.
